review_candidates.description: Company Description Amjaad Technology is a leading corporation in IoT and utility management, specializing in smart metering solutions for electricity, water, BTU, and gas. Through its innovative ioMeter System, the company supports utility providers, real estate developers, and smart cities in driving digital transformation, optimizing energy use, and achieving sustainability goals. Amjaad Technology builds platforms for community and facilities management in smart cities to enhance efficiency, improve resource utilization, and streamline operations. With over 300 projects delivered across Egypt, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE, its solutions have positively impacted more than 200,000 people and contributed to the creation of sustainable communities. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Automation Tester (Mid Level) role based in Qesm El Maadi. Day-to-day responsibilities include creating and executing test cases, performing manual and API testing, analyzing test results, reporting defects, and collaborating with developers and product teams to resolve issues. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Experience testing IoT, utilities, or enterprise SaaS platforms is a plus. Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams and adapt to evolving project requirements.

review_candidates.description: AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals and minerals – safely, efficiently and more sustainably. We’re the first software business in the world to have our sustainability targets validated by the SBTi, and we’ve been recognized for the transparency and ambition of our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We’ve also recently been named as one of the world’s most innovative companies. If you’re a curious and collaborative person who wants to make a big impact through technology, then we want to hear from you! Find out more at AVEVA Careers. For more information about our privacy policy and how to manage cookies, visit our Privacy Policy . Job Title: Account Manager Location: Cairo, Egypt - hybrid Employment Type: full-time The Job The Strategic Account Manager's purpose is to develop business with new accounts and expand our footprint within existing named accounts in a defined territory. The primary goal is to meet revenue objectives and maximize AVEVA solutions and services within these accounts. This person should be a team player and be able to positively conduct challenging business and commercial conversations with customers. Key Responsibilities Meet or exceed quarterly incremental revenue targets supporting the regional business plan. Maximizing revenue growth and customer outcomes through a robust cross-portfolio sales strategy, utilizing the AVEVA Strategic Sales Plays, focusing on delivering the greatest impact to our customers’ business Direct the account new revenue generation whilst retaining accountabilities for all commercial activity within the account from opportunity inception to contract closure Define and execute on accounts using strategic and tactical approaches for achieving your targets Plan and organize all related sales activities starting from prospecting through to closing business in line with AVEVA’s policies and processes including other written and verbal communication Identify, pursue, and develop C- Level client relationships and, through the course of these interactions, deepen your understanding of the client’s digital initiatives and business drivers. These relationships will secure AVEVA’s position as a strategic partner providing significant value to the customer through transformational sales initiatives. Analyse ongoing performance using salesforce to provide monthly performance reporting, including long-term account strategies with current and proposed activities, customer visits, revenue status, and revenue forecast. Maintain and develop the customer pipeline following the AVEVA MEDDPICC, forecasting protocols, and maintain all activity within AVEVA’s CRM solution (Salesforce). Essential Requirements Significant experience in sales, account management, or business development role selling software solutions across Utilities and Infrastructure, O&G, Transmission & Distribution, EPCs and parallel sectors, serving Owner Operators, EPCs, or Design consultants. Well versed and experienced with IT Software and Solutions, business drivers and sector specific trends within the industries served by AVEVA (O&G, Transmission & Distribution, Water and Wastewater, Infrastructure, Manufacturing, Life Sciences/Pharma, Mining, Metals, Materials/Marine). You will be a self-starter, able to work to develop new client engagements through the entire sales cycle. Skilled and experienced in operating at various levels, from end-user to senior decision-makers within AVEVA’s target customer base, aligning their business problems with our technology solutions. A strong understanding of the business benefits of the AVEVA solutions and services, able to describe the product benefits and advise how these may benefit customers personally. Ability to be insightful about the customer’s business and be able to investigate and uncover their most important problems to solve, matching AVEVA’s solutions to them where appropriate. Commercial and analytical skills to identify market trends and opportunities for your nominated territory, creating dynamic business and account plans to exploit such opportunities. Strong communication skills in all forms – written, oral, email, presentation etc. Fluency in English and the local language to C1/C2 level is required Desired Skills Domain expertise in an appropriate industry or market sector Degree qualified or a professional qualification in a relevant area to the key AVEVA industries Commercial at AVEVA Our Commercial team, comprised of over 2,000 dedicated colleagues, is the backbone of our customer relationships and business growth. From industry experts and solution architects to sales, support, success managers, and business operations, everyone shares a common goal: to deeply understand our customers' needs and deliver tailored solutions. If you're passionate about driving growth, tackling complex business challenges, and fostering strong customer relationships, you'll find success and fulfilment in our Commercial team. Find out more: https://www.aveva.com/en/about/careers/ AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third party personal data may involve additional background check criteria. AVEVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. Come and join AVEVA to create the transformative technology that enables our customers to engineer a better world.

review_candidates.title: Web Developer
review_candidates.description: Overview ENERPAC – Who we are? Enerpac Tool Group Corp. is a premier industrial tools, services, technology and solutions provider serving a broad and diverse set of customers in more than 100 countries. The Company makes complex, often hazardous jobs possible safely and efficiently. Enerpac Tool Group’s businesses are global leaders in high pressure hydraulic tools, controlled force products, and solutions for precise positioning of heavy loads that help customers safely and reliably tackle some of the most challenging jobs around the world. The Company was founded in 1910 and is headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin. Enerpac Tool Group common stock trades on the NYSE under the symbol EPAC. For further information on Enerpac Tool Group and its businesses, visit the Company's website at https://www.enerpactoolgroup.com/. Summary – Basic Function Of The Role We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Web Developer to join our global digital team in Madrid. This hybrid role will be based onsite at our Madrid location four days per week, with the option to work from home on Fridays. You will design, develop and maintain web applications, content-managed websites and eCommerce platforms that support customers, distributors and internal teams around the world. You will contribute to the continued development of our recently launched US eCommerce site and participate in the creation and migration of additional global websites, including sites across EMEA and APAC. Working with modern Web Content Management Systems and eCommerce platforms, you will help deliver reliable functionality, accessible and responsive user experiences, and high-quality digital content. You will receive clear business and functional direction while independently managing weekly development priorities and seeing technical issues through to resolution. This role is suited to a proactive and accountable developer who enjoys investigating problems, raising potential risks and taking practical action. You will collaborate with colleagues across multiple countries and time zones, so some flexibility may occasionally be required when urgent eCommerce or website issues arise. Job Duties And Responsibilities Develop, maintain and enhance web applications using React, Next.js, Node.js, HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Use REST and XML APIs to integrate external systems, back-end services and third-party applications. Implement and maintain Server-Side Extensions (SSEs) that consume back-end data and third-party APIs. Develop and maintain content-managed websites and eCommerce experiences using platforms such as Kibo Commerce, Optimizely and Oracle Commerce Cloud. Support the creation and migration of global websites, ensuring content, functionality and integrations transition successfully between platforms. Manage source code and development activity using GitHub, Azure DevOps or comparable version-control platforms. Participate in DevOps and CI/CD practices, supporting automated build, testing and deployment processes while reducing merge conflicts and maintaining stable development and production environments. Apply technical SEO and web-performance best practices to improve website speed, accessibility and discoverability. Maintain high standards through careful self-testing, code reviews and quality checks, including when dedicated QA support is unavailable. Plan and manage development activities, including prioritising work, estimating effort, communicating progress and delivering features within agreed timelines. Design and develop responsive websites using libraries and frameworks such as Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS or Foundation. Follow and promote coding standards and development best practices to support maintainable, secure and scalable applications. Investigate and resolve complex technical issues using tools such as LogRocket, Wireshark, server logs, analytics and code-based monitoring. Identify the root causes of recurring issues and implement preventative improvements. Raise questions, risks and technical concerns early, providing clear and actionable recommendations. Collaborate with functional, creative and technical colleagues across different locations and time zones. Support urgent eCommerce incidents when required, working with the wider team to restore services and minimise customer impact. Continuously improve development workflows and contribute to documentation, team learning and knowledge sharing. Skills And Competencies Proven web-development experience using React, Next.js, Node.js, HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Experience integrating applications through REST and XML APIs. Experience working with modern Web Content Management Systems and eCommerce platforms. Knowledge of Kibo Commerce, Optimizely or Oracle Commerce Cloud would be beneficial. Experience using responsive frameworks or libraries such as Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS or Foundation. Familiarity with .NET frameworks is advantageous but not essential. Experience implementing Server-Side Extensions or comparable server-side and real-time web technologies. Strong knowledge of version-control tools such as GitHub or Azure DevOps. Experience with DevOps and CI/CD practices, including automated builds, testing, deployment and environment management. Understanding of technical SEO, website accessibility and web-performance optimisation. Ability to test, investigate and troubleshoot applications independently. Strong personal project-management skills, including prioritisation, estimation, organisation and follow-through. Ability to take ownership of technical issues and progress them through to resolution. A proactive approach to identifying risks, asking questions and recommending practical improvements. Experience diagnosing complex issues across code, APIs, platforms, logs and analytics tools. Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical colleagues across different cultures and time zones. Clear written and verbal communication skills. Commitment to quality, continuous improvement and an inclusive team environment. Education And Experience A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering or a related subject, or equivalent professional experience. At least four years of professional web-development experience. Experience gained within an eCommerce team, digital agency, software business or similarly fast-moving digital environment would be valuable.
